blockers.error: RAF (compressed, lossless and lossy, Bayer and X-Trans) NOT switched: the codec is only partly recovered. Derived from the oracle (GFX 50S II lossless, block 0, full-frame DNG via a patched crop 0x110-0x113): IS header (bytes 2 lossless flag, 3 CFA type, 4 bits, 5-6 height, 7-8 rounded width = blocks x 768, 9-10 width, 11-12 block width 768, 13 block count, 14-15 six-row line count), u32 BE block sizes, blocks from the next 16-byte boundary; MSB-first JPEG-LS-style limited Golomb codes (A0 = 256, N0 = 1, RESET 64, k = min k with N<<k >= A, MErrval = 2E or -2E-1, escape after 41 zeros + 14 bits); per row two colour vectors, even slots first and odd slots lagging 5 pairs (R0 G0 R2 G2 ... R8 G8 R1 G1 R10 G10 R3 ...); first line: even pred 0 in one context, odd pred (L+R)/2 with value = pred - E; next G line: even pred (p[s-1] + 2 p[s] + p[s+1]) / 4 of the previous G line. MISSING: the adaptive predictor switch (odd slots use (L+R)/2 or (L+R+2 up)/4 by an unrecovered rule; even slots deviate at edges), the odd/even context (gradient quantiser) rule, the context sign rule, X-Trans vector layout, the lossy quantiser. Uncompressed RAF (16-bit words, 12-bit LSB-first) matched the oracle in prototypes but is not built because the routed raf.rs also carries the compressed path.

CR3 (CRX) NOT started beyond container inspection: R6 track 3 CMP1 version 0x200 (C-RAW wavelet, adaptive QP); no public description of the CRX entropy coder or Canon's lifting/rounding; a black-box recovery needs the RAF-scale effort plus wavelet synthesis.

SR2 (lead addition) NOT done: the SR2SubIFD ciphertext is a fixed per-key keystream XOR (ILCE-7S x2, A200, 7S II with key 11 22 33 44: ciphertexts differ only where plaintext differs), the plaintext tags are public (ExifTool SR2SubIFD table), but no public description of the keystream generator exists; recovering it needs known plaintext over the whole SR2SubIFD length.

notes.rw2_rules: 16-bit words: LE u16 >> (16 - bits), 0 kept (LX1). Packed formats 2/5/7: floor(128/bits) samples per LE 128-bit word from bit 0, every row starts a new block (LX7 width-1900 probe), format 5 stored in 0x4000 chunks rotated by 0x1FF8 (GH5S, LX7 padded probe), formats 2/7 not rotated (FZ8; GH5S/LX7/LX3 format-7 probes), sample 0 = missing (FZ8 15 fills, LX7 probes 286). Codec 12 bit (formats 4/6): seeds 8-bit high + 4 low bits, high 0 = missing and deferred seed (LX7 2, G9 76, LX3 4 + probes), 4 groups of scale + three 8-bit codes, absolute when step 16 or prev < 128*step (code*step + low bits of prev), else (code-128)*step; format 4 rotated, code 0 keeps prev; format 6 not rotated, code 0 = missing (GH5M2 probe), samples - 15 (GH5M2). Codec 14 bit (format 6): plain 14-bit seeds, 3 groups of 10-bit codes, absolute without low bits (S1), value < 16 = missing (S1 probe), samples - 15. Missing fill: rounded mean of present same-colour neighbours (green diagonals, R/B two sites away). Black: tags (+15 for format 4). Known divergences: converter averages only inside its own crop (LX3 format-7 probe, 14 sites); converter wraps a format-6 12-bit value < 15 (crafted 3 -> 65524), decoder clamps to 0; values up to 4097 at 12 bit raise the white to the maximum. Format 8 stays decoder_unavailable (as before).
notes.nef_rules: 0x0096: byte 0 0x46 lossless / 0x44 lossy, four seeds in maker-note byte order, lossy count + points. Prefix codes recovered by backtracking fits of the stream to the converter planes: lossless 12 (D500, Z6 12-bit whole frames; categories 10-12 also by a re-encoded D500 probe, only the permutation 111110/1111110/1111111 decodes), lossless 14 (D3 whole frame, all 15 categories), lossy 12 (D70s, D2H, D200, D3 12-bit; its two remaining codes are not categories 11/12 by probe), lossy 14 (D3 14-bit, Z6 14-bit). Predictor: columns 0/1 vertical chains seeded by the 0x0096 seeds, others the sample two to the left; JPEG-style additional bits. Type-1 683-point curve = the converter's LinearizationTable bit for bit (D70s, D2H, D200); 257-point curves expanded linearly (UNVERIFIED: the converter uses its own tables for D3 and a non-linear one for Z6). Black: 0x003D / 4 at 12 bit, absent = 0 (converter BlackLevel 0 on every file without it). The DNG origin offsets (D3 x=2, D2H x=6, D200 x=1, FZ8 x=4, LX1 x=6) are pinned per case.
